SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.code AS product_code, p.price AS price, p.create_time AS create_time, IFNULL(x.out_qty, 0) AS out_quantity, IFNULL(x.in_qty, 0) AS in_quantity FROM product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, SUM(IF(change_type = 'OUT', change_quantity, 0)) AS out_qty, SUM(IF(change_type = 'IN', change_quantity, 0)) AS in_qty FROM stock_log
AND create_time >= #{startDate}
AND create_time <= CAST(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME)
GROUP BY product_id ) x ON x.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.id
SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM stock GROUP BY product_id
SELECT product_id, MAX(create_time) AS last_out FROM stock_log WHERE change_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY product_id
